lines.intro: A fizzy bluebird flutters round the music room with a chime mallet in its beak!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the flappy bluebird?

soothe.great: Fae speaks softly. The bluebird's wings slow to a gentle flutter!
soothe.good: Fae speaks softly, and the bluebird listens for a moment.
soothe.miss: The bluebird flaps too fast to hear Fae.

play.great: Maddie bats a bouncy ball across the music room. The bluebird swoops after it, mallet bobbing!
play.good: Maddie nudges a bouncy ball. The bluebird pauses its flutter to watch.
play.miss: Maddie swats at a ball... and it bonks her on the nose. The bluebird flaps higher with the mallet.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber across the music room. The bluebird follows its bright wiggle!
cast.good: Sue's bobber wiggles by. The bluebird tilts its head and wags its tail feathers.
cast.miss: Sue's ribbon bobber snags on the instrument shelf. The bluebird keeps flapping.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones in a big loop. The bluebird hops to the rhythm, mallet in its beak!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone up high. The bluebird chirps, curious.
juggle.miss: Jordan drops all three pinecones on the music room floor. The bluebird ruffles its feathers.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. The bluebird chirps happily, still holding the mallet.
lines.burst: The bluebird flaps hard and sends a fizzy gust through the music room!

burstResult.great: Fae ducks neatly under the fluttering swirl!
burstResult.good: Fae brushes a few feathers from her sleeve.
burstResult.miss: Poof! The gust scatters music sheets all around Fae.

lines.soothed: The bluebird hops down and drops the little wooden mallet.
lines.rest: The bluebird settles on the piano for a little rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away slowly. The bluebird flutters another circle around the music room.
